verdict.rationale: A national company registry with online filing could reasonably publish its operating hours, daily limits, or session timeouts before a founder starts, so this axis applies. The evidence pack only records HTTP 403 responses at robots.txt for mca.gov.in and nsws.gov.in, so nothing about such disclosures could be checked. With no evidence that these limits are published up front, the verdict is none; confidence is low because the content was walled off rather than shown to be missing.
